name: runway-mcp
description: Job-fit filter for international students — fetch jobs, check H-1B visa sponsorship, and score CV match in one call.
long_description:
runwayMCP gives Claude the real data it needs to evaluate job postings for international students (F-1/OPT) seeking US roles.

**What it does in one call (`analyze_job`):**
- Fetches the job posting from Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, or any board with schema.org markup
- Checks the company's H-1B sponsorship history against USCIS data
- Loads your stored general resume text so Claude can score the match (0–100)
- Returns an `APPLY / CONSIDER / SKIP` recommendation

**Setup:** After installing, tell Claude to save your resume: *"Save my resume text with save_resume_version"* (paste or point Claude at your CV — Claude drafts the text, the server just stores it).

**Supported job boards:** Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, and any board that embeds `schema.org/JobPosting` markup (many Workday and ADP pages work via generic fallback).

**How it works:** The tools fetch and shape data; Claude drafts and tailors your resume text, scores the fit, and decides what to save. No MCP sampling is used, so it works on any host.

tools.name: analyze_job
tools.description: Loads your general resume and a scoring guide for a job you are evaluating. Claude scores the match against the job posting text in the conversation and applies the APPLY/CONSIDER/SKIP rules; the server does not fetch postings or score.

tools.name: save_resume_version
tools.description: Save a new resume version (raw text). The first save with parent_id=None establishes your general resume; later saves can tailor it for a specific job via parent_id and job_url.

tools.name: get_resume_version
tools.description: Retrieve a resume version by id, or the most recently saved one via id="latest".

tools.name: list_resume_versions
tools.description: List saved resume versions (newest first), optionally filtered by job_url. Returns summaries, not full text.

tools.name: save_job_analysis
tools.description: Persist an analyzed job's title, company, visa verdict, score, and recommendation. Upserts by URL.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List stored job records, optionally filtered by application status (one value or a list), minimum score, or date, sorted and limited.

tools.name: set_application_status
tools.description: Set a stored job's application status (not_applied, applied, interviewing, offer, rejected, withdrawn, ghosted). Any status can transition to any other.
